subject: econ
source: Cambridge IGCSE Economics 0455 syllabus 2027–2029, Cambridge International

weeks.topic: The basic economic problem: scarcity, needs and wants
objectives: Define the basic economic problem
Distinguish economic goods from free goods

weeks.topic: Factors of production: land, labour, capital and enterprise
objectives: Identify the four factors and their rewards
Explain influences on the mobility and quality of factors

weeks.topic: Opportunity cost and decision making
objectives: Define opportunity cost
Apply opportunity cost to consumers, workers, firms and governments

weeks.topic: Production possibility curves
objectives: Draw and interpret PPC diagrams
Explain movements along and shifts of the PPC

weeks.topic: The allocation of resources: the market system
objectives: Identify the key economic questions
Explain how the price mechanism allocates resources

weeks.topic: Demand: the demand curve and conditions of demand
objectives: Draw a demand curve and explain the law of demand
Explain the causes of shifts in demand

weeks.topic: Supply: the supply curve and conditions of supply
objectives: Draw a supply curve and explain the law of supply
Explain the causes of shifts in supply

weeks.topic: Price determination: market equilibrium and disequilibrium
objectives: Identify equilibrium price and quantity
Explain excess demand and excess supply

weeks.topic: Price changes: effects of shifts in demand and supply
objectives: Analyse changes in equilibrium using diagrams
Apply analysis to real markets

weeks.topic: Price elasticity of demand (PED)
objectives: Calculate and interpret PED
Explain determinants of PED and its link to total revenue

weeks.topic: Price elasticity of supply (PES)
objectives: Calculate and interpret PES
Explain the determinants of PES

weeks.topic: The market economic system: advantages and disadvantages
objectives: Describe the market economic system
Evaluate its advantages and disadvantages

weeks.topic: Market failure: public goods, merit goods and demerit goods
objectives: Define public, merit and demerit goods
Explain why markets fail to provide them efficiently

weeks.topic: Market failure: externalities, private and social costs and benefits
objectives: Distinguish private, external and social costs and benefits
Explain the consequences of externalities

weeks.topic: Term 1 review: the basic economic problem and allocation of resources
objectives: Consolidate demand, supply and elasticity diagrams
Practise short-answer and data questions

weeks.topic: The mixed economic system and government intervention in markets
objectives: Explain maximum and minimum prices, taxes and subsidies
Evaluate regulation, privatisation and nationalisation

weeks.topic: Money and banking: functions of money, central and commercial banks
objectives: Describe the functions and characteristics of money
Explain the roles of central and commercial banks

weeks.topic: Households: spending, saving and borrowing
objectives: Explain influences on household spending, saving and borrowing
Analyse how income and interest rates affect choices

weeks.topic: Workers: factors affecting choice of occupation and wage determination
objectives: Explain wage and non-wage factors in job choice
Analyse wage determination using demand and supply of labour

weeks.topic: Workers: division of labour and specialisation
objectives: Explain the division of labour
Evaluate specialisation for workers and firms

weeks.topic: Trade unions: role, influence and impact
objectives: Describe the role of trade unions
Evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of union membership

weeks.topic: Firms: classification, small firms and the growth of firms
objectives: Classify firms by sector and ownership
Explain why small firms survive and how firms grow

weeks.topic: Mergers, economies and diseconomies of scale
objectives: Distinguish horizontal, vertical and conglomerate mergers
Explain internal and external economies of scale

weeks.topic: Firms and production: labour- and capital-intensive production, productivity
objectives: Explain influences on the demand for factors of production
Distinguish production and productivity

weeks.topic: Firms' costs, revenue and objectives
objectives: Calculate fixed, variable, total and average costs
Calculate revenue and explain different objectives of firms

weeks.topic: Market structure: competitive markets and monopoly
objectives: Describe the characteristics of competitive markets and monopoly
Evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of monopoly

weeks.topic: Mid-year exams: microeconomics (Topics 1–3)
objectives: Sit multiple-choice and structured questions on micro topics
Identify topics for follow-up

weeks.topic: The role of government and macroeconomic aims
objectives: Describe the roles of government locally, nationally and globally
Identify the macroeconomic aims

weeks.topic: Fiscal policy: government budget and taxation
objectives: Explain the government budget and types of tax
Analyse the effects of fiscal policy

weeks.topic: Monetary policy
objectives: Explain the tools of monetary policy
Analyse the effects of changes in interest rates and money supply

weeks.topic: Supply-side policy
objectives: Describe supply-side measures
Evaluate their effects on the economy

weeks.topic: Economic growth: GDP, the business cycle and its causes
objectives: Define and measure economic growth using real GDP
Explain the phases of the business cycle

weeks.topic: Employment and unemployment: types, causes and consequences
objectives: Calculate the unemployment rate
Explain types, causes and consequences of unemployment

weeks.topic: Inflation and deflation: measurement, causes and consequences
objectives: Explain how CPI measures inflation
Distinguish demand-pull and cost-push inflation

weeks.topic: Applying macroeconomic aims: data response with real economies
objectives: Interpret macroeconomic data tables and graphs
Compare performance of Brazil and other economies

weeks.topic: End-of-year exams: Year 10 Economics
objectives: Sit papers on Topics 1–4
Use diagrams in structured answers

weeks.topic: Year 10 review and preview of economic development and trade
objectives: Correct exam errors
Preview development indicators and international trade
